## Source
- ColorLib: Eskwela (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/eskwela/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/eskwela/

## Section order
1. Navbar (logo "Eskwela", nav links, "Free Trial" CTA, transparent over hero)
2. Hero Slider (4 slides, Flexslider, centered white text, background images)
3. About Section (split: tabbed text left, 4 service icons right)
4. Classes Section ("Our Classes", 6 course cards, 3-col grid, light gray bg)
5. Trainers Section (instructor profiles, circular avatars)
6. Events Section (event entries with date badges)
7. Blog Section ("Latest Blog", 3 post cards, light gray bg)
8. Counter Section (4 stat counters, dark bg)
9. Footer (4 columns, newsletter form, dark bg)

## Tokens
- Primary: #429FFD (blue) | Secondary: #FFC300 (gold)
- Dark: #000 / #252525 | Light bg: #f2f3f7
- Fonts: Playfair Display (headings), Open Sans (body)
- Buttons: 30px radius (rounded), 100px (pill)
- Avatars: 50% (circular) | Cards: 4px radius
